blocks.text: Step into your game with the BlackShark V3 X HyperSpeed, with sound so clear and detailed, you’ll always be locked in to win. Experience crystal-clear, high-impact audio powered by Razer TriForce 50mm Gen-2 drivers. Next-gen tech that separates highs, mids, and lows for a level of precision that turns every sound cue into a competitive advantage. From subtle enemy footsteps to the click of a reload, hear it all with the clarity of a pro. Communicate with absolute confidence using the detachable Razer HyperClear Cardioid Mic. Armed with a 9.9mm capsule and tuned for vocal clarity, it cuts through background noise to deliver clean, focused voice pickup—because sharp shotcalls win games. Wherever you play, stay connected on your terms. With 3 modes of connectivity, you can switch effortlessly between Razer HyperSpeed Wireless for ultra-low latency, Bluetooth for mobile convenience, or plug and play with USB. No matter the platform, this headset keeps you in sync and in control. Let no footsteps go unheard with 7.1 surround sound for accurate positional audio, giving you spatial awareness that lets you react faster. Whether you’re clearing corners or scanning for danger, you’ll always know exactly where the action’s coming from. All this power comes packed in a 270g ultra-lightweight frame, designed for all-day competitive comfort.

items: TRIFORCE 50MM DRIVERS GEN-2 — Tuned for improved clarity and positional performance, the Gen-2 drivers not only deliver more powerful audio, but have an improved soundstage to clearly hear every footstep and audio cue
DETACHABLE HYPERCLEAR CARDIOID 9.9MM MIC — The mic’s unidirectional pickup pattern ensures more voice and less noise, while its detachable design allows for easy removal when not in use
HYPERSPEED WIRELESS — Featuring an ultra-fast 2.4 GHz wireless connection, enjoy high-performance, low-latency competitive play with sound that’s perfectly synced to the game

3 MODES OF CONNECTIVITY — Gain the competitive edge when gaming on PC, console or mobile; seamlessly switch between 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth with SmartSwitch Dual Wireless or stay plugged in for non-stop gaming via USB
7.1 SURROUND SOUND — With our advanced 7.1 surround sound, enjoy true-to-life acoustics that optimizes the game’s sound design to hear everything like being right in the middle of it all

270G ULTRA LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN — From material choice to design, the headset’s optimized weight reductions and plush earcups provide long-lasting comfort to power through the most intense scrims and tournaments
